<section class="dssm-section"><style>.dssm-destination{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.dssm-destination .dssm-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}.dssm-destination-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.dssm-destination-pair .dssm-menu-select-wrap{width:100%;min-width:0}.dssm-destination-pair .dssm-menu-select-wrap,.dssm-destination-pair span[class*="_root_"],.dssm-destination-pair .dssm-source-select-menu{display:flex!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;height:auto!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important}.dssm-destination-pair .dssm-menu-select-trigger{display:flex!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;height:36px!important;border-radius:var(--dsw-radius-md,10px)!important;padding:0 12px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}@media (max-width:420px){.dssm-destination-pair{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}.dssm-destination-path{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:0.5px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l2,rgba(127,127,127,.2));border-radius:var(--dsw-radius-lg,16px);background:var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1,rgba(127,127,127,.06));overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:12px;line-height:18px}.dssm-destination-unavailable{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.dssm-main-panel{box-sizing:border-box;height:100%;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:28px clamp(24px,4vw,48px) 48px}
.dssm-main-panel>*{width:100%;max-width:960px}
.dssm-bundle-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:0.5px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l2)}
.dssm-bundle-label-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0;flex:1;text-align:left}
.dssm-bundle-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:20px;color:var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)}
.dssm-bundle-desc{font-size:12px;line-height:18px;color:var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary)}
.dssm-sources{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.dssm-scope-tabs{display:grid!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;width:100%;height:32px!important;min-height:32px!important;max-height:32px!important;padding:2px!important;border-radius:var(--dsw-radius-sm,8px)!important;border:0.5px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l2)!important;background:var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1)!important}.dssm-scope-tabs>span[aria-hidden="true"],.dssm-scope-tabs>[class*="indicator"]{width:calc((100% - 4px)/4)!important;inset:2px auto 2px 2px!important;border-radius:6px!important;border:0.5px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l3,rgba(255,255,255,.12))!important;background:var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-3,rgba(255,255,255,.08))!important;box-shadow:none!important}.dssm-scope-tabs [role=tab]{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:6px!important;height:28px!important;padding:0 12px!important;border-radius:6px!important;font-size:13px!important;line-height:20px!important;color:var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary)!important;text-align:center!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;transition:color 150ms ease!important}.dssm-scope-tabs [role=tab]:hover{color:var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)!important}.dssm-scope-tabs [role=tab][aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)!important;font-weight:600!important}.dssm-scope-tabs [role=tab] svg{flex:none;display:block}.dssm-source-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;padding:8px 12px}.dssm-source-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.dssm-source-toggle:focus-visible{outline:var(--dsw-focus-ring-width,1px) solid var(--dsw-focus-ring-color,var(--dsw-alias-brand-primary));outline-offset:2px}.dssm-fold-chevron{flex:none;color:var(--dsw-alias-label-tertiary);transform:rotate(-90deg);tra
